purpose: Conformal volume sandwich using explicit LAW12 skins and unchanged source LAW28 core. Physical face sharing is a newly declared perfect-bond hypothesis; old Spot5 and whole aircraft inputs are preserved. Free physical invariants and manufactured elastic fields before surface-loaded coupling and real root insertion.

geometry.faces: identical node IDs at z=-4 and z=4, no duplicate interface masses, rigid-body offset or independent rotations

core.law: unchanged source LAW28/28 and constant plateau curves280..285
core.property: TYPE6 Isolid14 Ismstr4 Icpre3 Gauss222 Iframe2, same scalar property inputs as cached A20 core

loading.free_omega_reason: Keep low-strength core elastic: estimated rho*omega²*R² below weakest declared .1MPa yield. New sandwich amplitude declared before any native results, no claim of high-speed A29 amplitude equivalence.
loading.affine: ux=.001*x; uy=uz=0, all nodes prescribed. Constrained 3D extension, not free uniaxial contraction.
loading.bending: ux=-k*x*z-k²*x³/6;uy=0;uz=k*x²/2. All nodes prescribed, epsilon_y=epsilon_z=0 to first order. Constrained transverse bending, not free plate bending.
loading.small_strain_limit_reason: κ chosen for max skin strain4.5e-4 on9mm sandwich, same elastic order as A29 plate; not native response fit.

reference.extension: 0.5*epsilon²*sum(Cxx_region*physical_volume_region), J conversion1e-3 from native g/mm/ms energy
reference.bending: 0.5*kappa²*area*sum(Cxx_region*integral(z²dz)), source tensor, native values not used
reference.continuous_inertia: analytic sum of each layer rectangular prism about global origin including physical offset; compare separate known lumped tensor
reference.limitations: Manufactured fields constrain every node. They verify coupled native mass, conservation and constitutive response, not free interior transmission, delamination or real attachment capacity.
